cards.name: Video Cache
cards.summary: Frees the memory Photoshop holds for cached video and timeline frames (the frames rendered for Timeline playback). Nothing in the document changes; the purge cannot be undone and playback has to re-cache afterwards. Enabled with or without a document open.
use_for: releasing RAM after scrubbing a long video or frame-animation timeline before a heavy edit or export
recovering responsiveness when Photoshop warns it is low on memory during video work
avoid: routine still-image work: there is usually nothing in this cache to free; Purge > All or Histories frees more
the middle of a timeline review: playback has to rebuild every cached frame

cards.name: Redo
cards.summary: Re-applies the step that was last undone, moving one state forward in the History. It is greyed out until something has been undone (the harvest saw it disabled in every fresh scratch state).

cards.summary: Opens the Remote Connections dialog, where you allow other apps or devices on the network to connect to and drive Photoshop through its built-in connection server, identified by a service name and protected by a password. It is a network setting, not an image command.

cards.name: Sky Replacement
cards.summary: Detects the sky in a photo and swaps in another sky, masking the foreground (buildings, trees, hair) automatically and shifting the foreground light and colour to match. The result lands as a new editable layer group (sky layer, masks, colour adjustments) or a single duplicated, flattened layer.
cards.how: Pick a sky from the presets (or import your own sky image), then adjust Shift Edge and Fade Edge to fix the mask boundary; Brightness, Temperature, Scale and Flip for the new sky; Lighting Mode, Lighting Adjustment and Color Adjustment to blend the foreground; Output to New Layers (editable) or Duplicate Layer. The Sky Move and Sky Brush tools in the dialog reposition the sky and extend or shrink its area.
use_for: replacing a blown-out or grey sky in real-estate, travel or product-on-location photos
giving a campaign set a consistent sunset or blue-sky mood across several shots
quick key-visual comps before a full manual composite
avoid: skies broken up by fine detail (dense foliage, wire fences, hair against the sky): check the mask edge closely and refine with the Sky Brush or a manual mask
images without a clear sky region or with reflections of the sky (water, glass): the reflections keep the old sky; composite those by hand
unattended pipelines: the harvest only opened the dialog (DialogModes.ALL) and recorded no no-dialog descriptor, so a person has to pick the sky and click OK

cards.name: Stroke
cards.summary: Paints a solid-colour line of a set pixel width along the edge of the active selection (or around the content of the active layer when nothing is selected), directly into the layer's pixels.
cards.how: Width in pixels and Color; Location Inside, Center or Outside the edge; Blending Mode and Opacity of the painted line; Preserve Transparency to paint only where the layer already has pixels.
use_for: a quick keyline or frame around a selected area on a flat image
outlining a selection-based shape for a sticker, badge or cut-out border
drawing a border around the whole canvas (Select All, then stroke Inside)
avoid: anything that may change later: the stroke is baked into pixels; use the Stroke layer style or a shape layer's stroke for an editable outline
type, shape and smart object layers: they have no editable pixels, so stroke a new pixel layer above or use the Stroke layer style
very thin strokes on curved selections when crisp vector edges matter: they antialias; use a vector stroke
a group or several selected layers: Stroke was disabled in the harvest's group and multi-layer states; select one pixel layer

curving a headline or badge text after converting it to a smart object
avoid: warping a pixel layer more than once: resampling softens it; convert to a smart object so the warp stays editable
true 3D wraps with heavy foreshortening: build the mockup with a displacement map or 3D-aware tool
unattended runs: the menu command only opens an interactive mode
several selected layers or a group: Warp was disabled in the harvest's multi-layer and group states; convert them into one smart object first
cards.script_api: app.runMenuItem(stringIDToTypeID('warp')) (harvest candidate from a terminology label match, not run: it would only enter the interactive Warp mode). A preset style can likely be applied with the transform event carrying a warp descriptor (warpStyle, warpValue) (unverified). Do not call it from an unattended script: the sibling Puppet Warp candidate put Photoshop into its interactive mode and it stopped answering scripts until force-restarted (harvest 2026-10-04); if used, guard it with a timeout.

cards.name: Undo
cards.summary: Reverses the last change to the document. Choosing it again keeps stepping further back through the History, one state at a time, up to the history limit set in Preferences.
use_for: backing out of a mistaken brush stroke, transform or adjustment
stepping back through several edits to compare earlier versions
avoid: steps older than the history limit or before the file was reopened: take History snapshots or save versions
quick before/after comparison of one change: Toggle Last State flips without losing the redo
cards.script_api: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('undoEvent'), new ActionDescriptor(), DialogModes.NO) (harvest-verified 2026-10-04 on the 'filled' fixture: undoing its last state, a Deselect, brought the 40,40,200,200 selection back). History-state route: executeAction(stringIDToTypeID('select'), d, DialogModes.NO) where d.putReference(charIDToTypeID('null'), ref) and ref.putEnumerated(charIDToTypeID('HstS'), charIDToTypeID('Ordn'), charIDToTypeID('Prvs')) (unverified for Undo itself).
